children: Catcher Predict monitored a sharp swing in the Polymarket submarket for Pittsburgh Pirates vs. Chicago Cubs, where the Pittsburgh Pirates option rose from 40.5% one hour earlier to 62.5% at the time of reporting. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 22% increase and may have been affected by breaking news.

title: Polymarket Pittsburgh Pirates Option Jumps to 62.5% Amid Sharp Volatility
